Welcome to iQ Offices

iQ Offices is more than a coworking space—we’re a community. With premium office environments and thoughtful amenities, we’re here to elevate your workday through bespoke spaces designed to move your business forward.

Contact Us

Our Story

Alex Sharpe and Kane Willmott, both entrepreneurs, saw an opportunity to redefine the traditional workspace. They envisioned a professional environment that prioritized premium design, privacy, and a strong sense of community—one where individuals and teams could thrive.

What began as a mission to reimagine the workplace has grown into a Canadian-owned and operated company dedicated to providing thoughtfully designed spaces that support the evolving needs of modern professionals across the country.

Our Value Proposition

Our commitment to Service, Design, and Privacy drives everything we do. From thoughtfully crafted interiors to dedicated support and secure, private spaces, we create work environments that meet the highest professional standards. Discover how our core values shape an exceptional work experience.

Discover Our Values

Our Team

We're dedicated to providing premium workspaces where our Members can thrive. With diverse expertise and a commitment to excellence, we foster a supportive and innovative environment that goes beyond your day-to-day work.

Work With Us

We’re passionate about creating exceptional workspaces where individuals and teams can thrive, and as part of our team, you’ll help redefine the modern workspace while growing your career in a collaborative environment. iQ Offices is also Great Place To Work® Certified, reflecting our commitment to a high trust, employee driven culture, and we invite you to explore opportunities across Canada and join a community that values innovation, design, and exceptional service.
